name: Tiro

wants.text: A full hold and an early tide
A favor owed by someone useful

fears: a winter crossing with a tired crew
contradiction: He complains about passengers and cannot afford to lose them.

provenance.notes: An invented shipmaster; maritime traffic between the Levant and Cyprus is attested in general terms.

voice.register: Fatalistic shipmaster. Names the sea instead of the fear; bargaining as ritual.
tics: mending rope that does not need mending
sampleLines: Everyone wants the island, and the island does not want any of us.
A man who works is easier to take than one who does not.
